newsitem.title: USA: Sanmina to acquire Lucent unit.
newsitem.headline: Sanmina to acquire Lucent unit.

text.p: Sanmina Corp Thursday said it has reached an agreement in principle to acquire most of the assets of Lucent Technologies' Custom Manufacturing operation in Greensboro, North Carolina.

Originally formed as an operation within AT&T Corp in December 1993, The Custom Manufacturing Services business provides manufacturing services to companies that design and sell communications and networking equipment.
Examples of products made at this factory include local and wide area network switches, integrated-circuit testers, videoconferencing equipment and high-security phones and modems.

Under the terms of the proposed sale, most of the equipment in the Greensboro factory will be moved to Sanmina factories in Raleigh and other U.S. cities. In addition, it is anticipated that many of Lucent's current CMS customers will transfer their business to Sanmina.

The acquisition, which is expected to close by the end of this year, is subject to the satisfactory negotiation and execution of definitive agreements and the completion of due diligence and other customary closing conditions. Further terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
